newsitem.title: CHINA: China light industry, electronics investment soars.
newsitem.headline: China light industry, electronics investment soars.

text.p: Chinese boosted investment in fixed assets in light industry and the electronics sectors soared by more than 25 percent in the first 11 months of 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

Investment in light industry fixed assets totalled 44.53 billion yuan ($5.37 billion) between January and November, up 36.1 percent from the same period of 1995, it quoted the State Statistical Bureau as saying.
Investors pumped 16.11 billion yuan into electronics industry fixed assets during the first 11 months, a year-on-year rise of 38.8 percent, the agency said.
Investment in textile industry fixed assets was 14.17 billion yuan, up 3.6 percent, while the machinery sector absorbed 31.11 billion yuan, up 12 percent.
